category.description: bug: a tool errored or returned something wrong. missing_capability: no tool can do what the task needs. confusing_tool: a tool's name, parameters or description led you astray. docs: the guide/primer is wrong or missing something. other: anything else.

expected.description: What you expected or needed instead.

proposed_fix.description: A concrete change to the MCP: a new parameter, a new tool, a schema or default change, a reworded description, a better error message. Be specific enough that an engineer could implement it.

severity.description: high: blocked the user's task. medium: worked around it at real cost. low: papercut.

summary.description: One line: the problem, as an issue title.

tool_name.description: The tool this is about, if one (e.g. 'update_keyframes').

what_happened.description: What you were trying to do for the user, the calls you made (tool + the relevant arguments), and what came back or went wrong. Include error text verbatim.

workaround.description: How you got around it, if you did (and what that cost: extra calls, a worse result).

name: report_feedback
title: Report MCP feedback
